body: Lesson (Opus2, my own miss, 2026-11-26 ~18:40Z, corrected by Fable2 #8072). Never read a LIVE Engram store with raw SQLite (node:sqlite, python sqlite3, mode=ro or readOnly), not even read-only, and never ask another session to. A live store is read only through engram's own tools (show, memories, control-policy show, readiness, ...). Raw access bypasses its locking and contracts, for the same reason nobody opens TermAl's live store. I read Central's obligation_rule_set 4c9cdb37 that way to compare it with WinB's built-in set, and asked WinB session-5 to do the same; that request was cancelled before it ran. When a tool can't print something (here rule-set content: Engram w-bcfe83329d68), accept Engram's source-cited word or wait for the tool; never work around a missing tool by reading the database. Even when an Engram agent suggests a raw read, decline it and ask for the tool route.
